title: The mental has a first-person ontology

statements.text: Because mental phenomena are essentially connected with consciousness, and consciousness is essentially subjective, the ontology of the mental is a first-person ontology: a conscious state exists only as experienced by a subject. This subjectivity is a fact about what exists, not only about how it is known.

sources.locator: p. 195, quoting The Rediscovery of the Mind, p. 20
sources.quote: it follows that the ontology of the mental is essentially a first-person ontology
